headline.purpose: Names the internal destination or tenant.

components.name: Tenant Status
components.description: Text-first active or suspended tenant status using semantic feedback tokens.
components.css: .ds-tenant-status { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--feedback-success-border); border-radius: 9999px; padding: .25rem .75rem; color: var(--feedback-success-foreground); background: var(--feedback-success); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Support Boundary
components.description: Persistent structural signature for reason-bound, expiring, read-only support.
components.css: .ds-support-boundary { position: sticky; top: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: .75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--feedback-warning-border); background: var(--feedback-warning); color: var(--feedback-warning-foreground); }

narrative.overview: A calm navy-and-gold internal control room where operator authority and tenant state are always explicit.

rules.name: Gold Is Scarce
rules.body: Use gold only for identity, focus, selection, and primary action.

rules.name: State Has Text
rules.body: Never communicate tenant, subscription, or authority state by color alone.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Use boundaries and tonal layers before elevation.

donts: Do not import Studio business modules
